design.decision: Cash top honors before anyone is void, or open a run, knowing the lead before you bid.
design.opponent: Revealed on the first round in which it moves the lead.
design.rationale: The opening lead is a real Spades edge. This gives a fixed, build-agnostic lead-control enabler at common, simpler than seed-lead-choice (-6.6), which the AI may struggle to use.
design.draftText: Your team leads the first trick of a round
design.hooks: Lead-control hook: the kernel sets the first leader to the owning team's seat that comes first after the dealer. If both teams own it, the normal rotation stands (fixed priority).

critic.concerns: Text doesn't say which partner leads, or what happens when both teams own it; that rule lives only in the kernel.
